title: HY4 Flash (high)
notes: Live 24-hour autonomous v4.1 run on opencode 2.4.2 (--thinking high). 5/5 valid host checkpoints through 10.0h, climbing from 1.358x (2h) -> 1.385x (4h) -> 1.387x (8h) -> 1.417x at 10.0h (29.4% console frame time saved, 1.100x vs GCC -O2, 1.000 SSIM across all 26 routes) via GCC -O2, F3DEX2 microcode, once-per-frame LookAt emission, shadow graph hoisting, and synthesis object I-cache padding.
